tei:div.tei:p: (323)dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas tshe 'das la phan btags pa'i 'dul gyi phrin las sbyar tshul bzhugs/

bla ma ngag gi dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo// gtor bzlog dang sbrel na de'i chas dang*/ drag po'i sbyin sreg gi shoms/ 'dul dkar gnas lung zhi khro ngan sbyong ba'i gzhan phan thugs rje'i drwa ba 'di rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dgongs pa bdun tshig gzhan las lhag par gsungs pas de sbyor tshul la/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng sum pa bcud ldan a bzhis mtshan pa/ mchod pa brgya rtsa'i bskor/ sbyang cha sogs kyang 'du byas nas/ rang gzhung bzlas pa grub pa dang*/ shu n+ya ta/ bum pa 'od lnga'i sogs bskyed bzlas/ rang dbang chen rdo rje gro lod du gsal ba'i sogs kha bsgyur/ mchod bstod 'od zhu bcas (324)bya/ bka' srung rjes na raka skong bshags/ tshogs byin rlabs nas lhag ma yan grub pa dang*/ drag po'i sbyin sreg kha bsgyur gsham gsal ltar btang*/ bdag nyid 'jug pa dbang chog ltar ro/ rig me dor/ gnang ba zhu/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma sogs nas rten bskyed 'gugs pa/ bcom ldan 'das dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi lha tshogs zhes kha bsgyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bar dang*/ me chu til gsum bshams la/ mri khrol rā ga'i gsung ni/ tshe 'das rnam shes a yig dkar po de: nṛ yig sngo skya k+ṣa yig (ra )dmar skya yi: drwa ba rus pa lpags pa'i tshul du gtums: bdag gi thugs las hūm̐ yig dkar po dang : phaṭa yig dmar ser dpag med 'phros pa yis: nṛ dang k+ṣa yi drwa ba dngos med (325)bshigs: til me chur dor/ anṛ k+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ brgya rtsa brjod/ dkon mchog gsum dang rdo rje gro lod kyi: bden pa chen pos tshe 'das 'di nyid kyi: 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor skrag snang 'ur 'jigs kyi: bag chags ngan pa'i gri gtsang bral gyur cig: sor bsnol phyir dral oṃ badz+ra ban+dha tra thaḥ oṃ badz+ra bhid tra thaḥ las chus ming byang bran/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭaḥ me chu dor ba lan gsum bskor/ oṃ badz+ra bhid tra thaḥ ces phyir dor/ dri gos mtshan byang tshe 'das lus su gsal:
